findings.summary: QLinearGlobalAveragePool removed support for channels_last=1, replacing it with an assertion that crashes
findings.failure_scenario: Any ONNX model that passes channels_last=1 to QLinearGlobalAveragePool will now hit `assert channels_last == 0` and crash with AssertionError. The old code handled channels_last=1 by permuting the input from NHWC to a spatial-first format before pooling.
